headline: Mexican stock market extends rebound; shares of GAP and Grupo Carso stand out
summary: Mexico's local indices extended their gains after snapping a six-day losing streak that began following a record high. Shares of GAP and Grupo Carso stood out.
why: The S&P/BMV IPC is Mexico's main benchmark, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Its moves reflect local investor sentiment and foreign flows into Mexican equities.
why_moved: The local indices extended their gains after cutting a six-day negative run that followed a record high. Shares of GAP and Grupo Carso were singled out in the rally.
original_headline: Bolsa mexicana extiende el repunte; destacan acciones de GAP y Grupo Carso
